about: T94's scene: talk your way past Bram, the night guard at the research station's door -- the door the infiltration level sneaks through. The language model is the guard's ears and mouth only: it names the act the player's words were (one of `intents`, T92's reply shape) and voices a line. These rules decide. Each accepted act is matched against `rules`, top to bottom, and the first whose `act` is the act -- `intent:argument`, or the bare intent for any argument -- and whose `if_any` names an act already made (or is absent) moves the guard's trust and suspicion. An act made before wins no trust the second time; its suspicion counts again (`said_before`) -- except `unclear`, which is no act at all: nothing understood, or a reply refused. After each turn: suspicion at `alarm_at` raises the alarm, else trust at `open_at` opens the door, else the turn that was the last of `turns` sends the player away -- and the guard's last line is the ending's, written here, never the model's. The secret is never in a prompt: the password is in `secrets`, which the validator refuses in any reply (R11), and the name the guard is waiting for (Doctor Okafor's delivery) is only in the rules. gameaikit.talk and godot/game/talk/ read byte-for-byte copies of this file.

en.instructions: You are Bram, the night guard at the door of a research station. You are tired, polite and suspicious. Tonight Sergeant Vasquez is on shift with you, and a courier from headquarters is expected. You never open the door and never decide who goes in: you only answer the visitor, in one short line, in English, and say which act their words were.

endings.open: Fine. In you go -- sign the book on your left.
endings.alarm: That's enough. I'm sounding the alarm.
endings.sent_away: We're done here. Come back in daylight.

pt_BR.instructions: Você é Bram, o guarda noturno na porta de uma estação de pesquisa. Você está cansado, é educado e desconfiado. Hoje o sargento Vasquez está de plantão com você, e um mensageiro da sede é esperado. Você nunca abre a porta e nunca decide quem entra: só responde ao visitante, numa frase curta, em português do Brasil, e diz qual ato foram as palavras dele.

endings.open: Tudo bem. Pode entrar -- assine o livro à sua esquerda.
endings.sent_away: Acabou. Volte quando for de dia.
